QUOTE: **Verification is by Valgrind, not by inspection.** `test_with_valgrind_constant_time` runs `tests/suites/*constant_time*.data` under Valgrind.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: It mentions Valgrind-based testing, but never says the facility is off-by-default, built on MSan/valgrind as a separate facility, or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
